verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that the MCP server separates reads from writes and deletes, so each category can be approved independently. That lets an agent be limited to reads, but it is a client-side approval control, not a scoped credential. Integration API keys are documented only for sending data in, and the App API covers both sending and fetching data, with nothing showing a read-only key option. Missing for 10: documented scoped or read-only API key creation, per-credential permission settings that block sends, and contractor-level access controls.
